activation: No active pointer or laboratory route. For future explicit review only.
availability: Retrospective FTN classification; outcome may be known to annotator. Not pre-snap or independent pre-event prediction.

files.consumer/index.json: Version, fixed model/hash, coverage including pending games, all players, summary, interpretation, attribution.
files.consumer/players/{gsis_id}.json: All eligible passes, source game_id/play_id, GSIS, audited name/position, team, dates, FTN, observed interception, p_interception_given_ftn, authorized context and audit-only description.
files.players.csv: Complete numeric table, alphabetical order. No causal ranking.
files.pass_predictions.parquet: Complete per-pass population and fixed model predictions.
files.integrity.json: SHA-256 for every scientific package file; environment inventory excluded.
files.sources.json: Pinned sources, original public URL, acquisition time, byte size, hash, attribution and license.
files.fixed.json: Fixed model SHA-256, training years, original development freeze SHA-256, update policy and inference code hashes.

playerFields.gsis_id: Identity; do not join by abbreviated name.
playerFields.name: Weekly roster full name, fallback PBP display name if missing or conflicting; inspect position_class.
playerFields.position_class: qb / other / unknown_or_conflicting. Never use as a fit or population filter.
playerFields.teams: All observed teams in period; same GSIS remains same player after transfer.
playerFields.eligible_passes: Included official attempts after preserved eligibility; not all dropbacks or all official attempts including spikes.
playerFields.ftn_interception_worthy_passes: Observed FTN=1 count, not expected interceptions.
playerFields.observed_interceptions: Observed PBP interceptions on the included passes.
playerFields.expected_interceptions: Canonical sum expected_from_ftn_1 + expected_from_ftn_0; estimate of observed-INT target, never M3 expected interception-worthy passes.
playerFields.expected_from_ftn_0: Sum of p_interception_given_ftn over FTN=0, including interceptions outside FTN=1.
playerFields.observed_minus_expected: Positive means more observed INT than the retrospective estimate.
playerFields.difference_per_100_passes: 100*(observed_interceptions-expected_interceptions)/eligible_passes; unit is interceptions per 100 eligible passes.
playerFields.small_support: Below 100 passes, descriptive visibility flag; retain all rows.
playerFields.player_interval_status: not_estimated; no skill or player uncertainty intervals in v1.

arithmetic: Binary64. Per-player stored total is constructed by adding the two stored contributions; JSON consumer reconstructs that exact canonical addition. Cross-player and pass summation use tolerance atol=1e-10 due to floating-point associativity. Numerical equivalence does not imply byte equality.
interpretation: Residual cannot automatically identify luck, blame, decision quality, drops, or individual responsibility. The annotation may know the outcome. Known seasons evaluated temporally out of fit, not untouched confirmation.
